'''S.P. Tre Penne''' is a [[multi-sports club]] based in the [[City of San Marino]]. It is best known for their [[association football|football]] section. Literally meaning the "Three Feathers", the club was founded in 1956, and currently plays in [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]]. The team colors are blue and white when home, and red when away.

On 9 July 2013, Tre Penne became the first Sammarinese team to win a game in a European competition by defeating [[Shirak F.C.|Shirak]] 1–0 in the second leg of their [[2013–14 UEFA Champions League]] first qualifying round contest.<ref>{{cite web|title=Tre Penne Capitale del calcio sammarinese|date=10 July 2013 |url=http://www.smtvsanmarino.sm/sport/calcio-sammarinese/2013/07/10/tre-penne-capitale-calcio-sammarinese|publisher=SMTV|access-date=10 July 2013|archive-date=15 July 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130715045615/http://www.smtvsanmarino.sm/sport/calcio-sammarinese/2013/07/10/tre-penne-capitale-calcio-sammarinese|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/match/2011672--tre-penne-vs-shirak/ |title=UEFA |access-date=2016-07-13 |archive-date=2014-10-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141021105842/http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=2014/matches/round=2000475/match=2011672/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref>"}}
